query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple latest iPhone buy official Apple Store iPhone 2026
queries: Apple latest iPhone buy official Apple Store iPhone 2026

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone in the U.S. from:

- **Apple directly** — Apple Store, Apple Store app, or Apple’s online iPhone shop. This is usually the safest option for unlocked models, trade-in, AppleCare+, and in-store pickup. ([apple.com](https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone?cid=wwa-us-soc-iphn-trdnand-socl-rbwim-intd-infe-cpc-and-mob-aandt-gnt-broa-stp0lp-lfnnl-usen-hxvifmrb-andis-45ar-6s-hxvifm-amcar-frnge-na-verizon-na-na-04756914&utm_source=openai))
- **Major carriers** — **Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile**, and others; best if you want installment plans or carrier promos.
- **Authorized retailers** — **Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target, Amazon** — availability and promos vary.

As of the latest info I found, Apple’s current mainstream latest lineup is the **iPhone 17 family**, including **iPhone 17, iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone 17 Pro Max**, with the **iPhone 17e** as a newer entry-level model released in March 2026. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_iPhone_models?utm_source=openai))

**My recommendation:** buy from **Apple.com** if you want an unlocked phone and straightforward setup/trade-in; buy from your **carrier** if you’re looking for the biggest bill-credit deal.
